title: Optimal Transport: Old and New
tldr_zh: OT 理论百科：30 章覆盖对偶、位移插值、Monge 问题解、正则性、Ricci 曲率与梯度流；查证明时用，不作第一本
tldr_en: Villani's 30-chapter treatise: general Kantorovich duality, displacement interpolation, Monge problem, regularity, Ricci curvature and gradient flows; a reference, not a first read.
key_numbers: 30 chapters in 3 parts + 3 introductory chapters (TOC pp. IX-X); local text is the 2006-09-27 preprint (547 pp.)
Thm 4.1: optimal coupling exists on Polish spaces for lower semicontinuous cost bounded below (Ch. 4)
Preface: regularity theory 'most poorly represented', numerical simulation 'not addressed at all' (p. 3)
